comparisons.diagnostic_only: All new reversal, exact45 phase, D4 symmetry, starting-fraction, adjacent-f32, near45 major-axis, short/zero and window/direct-clip comparisons. No expected line bitmap, coverage count, tie choice, corner ownership or snapping law.
comparisons.gating: Unchanged original 66 baseline checks; all native receipts, guards, complements, color preservation and both layouts; two identical-input repeats; two direct/indexed equivalents; four reviewed exact dyadic baseline window/direct-clip controls; reviewed direct-clip Keep empty and wrong equality rejected.

coordinate_inputs: Deterministic fixed public seeds, exact dyadic arithmetic and adjacent binary32 steps only. No RNG, external geometry/input file, captured/private coordinates, packets, libraries or raster kernel.

coverage_design.adjacent_clip_phase: At all five phase anchors, step both direct-clip y values up/down by one f32 ULP; equal exponents preserve exact45. These ideal viewport values need not both be representable as window f32 inputs.
coverage_design.adjacent_window_phase: At +/-0.5, move both endpoint y values by one adjacent-f32 step of the far window endpoint. This exact common translation preserves 45 degrees; the near endpoint need not move by one ULP.
coverage_design.companions: Every new nominal-window pair has forward/reverse direct-clip companions. Exact dyadic input round trips are host-checked; shader/GPU arithmetic remains unobserved. Only the four already-reviewed baseline exact dyadic controls gate path equality.
coverage_design.long_seed: (4+f,4+f+phase) to (27+f,27+f+phase); f=0.5 for full phase/D4 grids
coverage_design.major_tie_bracket: At phase +0.5, independently step either x/y of either endpoint to next_up/next_down f32, both directions. These are explicitly near45, not exact45; staged projection may erase some steps.
coverage_design.short_direct_clip: Separate nonzero pair from one direct clip ULP on each axis, compared diagnostically against zero and CPU-reference collapse. No projected-length or snapping equivalence assumed.
coverage_design.starting_fraction_subset: Additional fractions use phase 0 and +/-0.5, both directions; f=0.5 is reused from full sweep.
coverage_design.symmetries: All eight D4 transforms at all five anchors, both endpoint directions; bit0 swaps xy, bit1 reflects x about 16, bit2 reflects y about 16.

outputs.diagnostics.jsonl: Actual native mask differences and XOR rows by case pair; UNOBSERVED when either valid readback is missing. CPU-reference bit comparison is separately labeled non-native.
outputs.generator.json: Family IDs, fixed deterministic recipes, budgets and non-gating comparison plan; no RNG seed or raster model.
outputs.inputs.json: Exact input binary32 bits plus explicitly labeled CPU staged projection references or direct clip input bits.
outputs.unchanged_native_payload: Both layouts retain every raw guarded shared-buffer byte, complementary query masks, color-before/after planes and command completion/error receipts.

position_modes.0: Existing reviewed nominal-window MSL expression, unchanged. Rust records staged binary32 arithmetic as a CPU reference, never native vertex readback.
position_modes.1: Unchanged reviewed tiny vertex entry loads direct clip xy binary32 values with z=0.5,w=1. No window arithmetic or instance offsets. Identity expression is not instrumented vertex readback.

projection_interpretation: Do not equate nominal window coordinates with actual hardware postprojection positions. CPU reference clip bits may differ from GPU evaluation/contraction despite fastMathEnabled=NO. Direct-clip companions and differing viewport dimensions are non-gating measurements of that distinction.
public_file_policy: No README or markdown files; exact source and output allowlists only.
qualification_scope: Finite native observations only; line_coverage_rule remains UNKNOWN and implementation_qualified remains false. No-GPU/unsupported/wrong-device/incomplete/failing run is UNQUALIFIED, never a skip/pass.
remote_actions: This source is separately reviewed by Main. Only the generic allowlist is eligible for the authorized public validation repository.
viewports: All new inputs use 32x32 full viewport/scissor with consumed positions strictly inside (0,32). Original 66 retain their reviewed viewports/scissors/clipping, including the 16x16 inset.
